svg.title: Cecil compares two record omissions with the live server cupboard.
svg.desc: The utility register reserves an active demand trace but has no current Municipal Hall service premises. A separate internal plan shows a blank wall. Cecil's scan leads from both contradictions to operating server equipment and its small table fan, and Riju recognises that the first omission could interrupt the Hall's power.
